label: SAVANTE

provenance.reason: This office has never been cloned. There is no photograph, no landmark set, and therefore no faceprint. The founder template draiml.persona carries a real faceprint and fourteen clone proportions; this bundle carries none, and says so.
provenance.deciding_experiment: Run faicey /clone-face against a real image (or perspectives, or video) and record the twelve ordered ratios, their toFixed18 encoding, the precisionScore and the resulting hash with its params. Only that fills these fields.

_why: faice/1 is voaice/1's sibling, and it inherits the same rule: nulls mean nothing was
measured. A faceprint is a hash of twelve ratios drawn from a real measurement, so a
fabricated one is indistinguishable from a real one until somebody tries to reproduce
it — which is exactly why an unearned value here is a defect and not a placeholder.
The persona's embodiment.face is pointer 14 of the doctrine root. Filling faceprint or
cloneProportions with a plausible number is named, in the office's own binding document,
as an edit that voids the office. The bundle would rather carry a hole with a reason.
persona_print stays null BY CONSTRUCTION, not by choice: personaPrint() throws when both
modalities are absent, so no bundle can carry a persona print it did not earn.
Encoding note for whoever fills this in: faice uses toFixed18 (nine real decimals, then
padded), while voaice uses floor(v * 1e18) with a float 1e18. They disagree in the low
digits on purpose. Do not write a shared helper.
